After passing through the PRDS, MP steam is connected to the LP process steam header. Spray water for De-superheater is provided from the HRSG boiler feed pump discharge. 5.2.5 Auxiliary Equipment in Steam and Condensate Network One common feed water de-aerator capable of heating and de-aerating the process-condensate return water and make-up water is considered. The de-aerator is mounted on a horizontal feed water storage tank of 20 minutes holding capacity. Low-pressure chemical dosing systems are considered for dosing chemicals into the deaerator to control the boiler feed water quality.
